correctness.rationale: In Petrukhin’s arXiv v1 Definitions 2.5–2.6, the propositional clauses preserve the classical pair t,f. For an everywhere classical immediate subformula, each test for either i=b,n or its conflation *i fails everywhere. In the un-tilded essence clause the truth implication is vacuous and the falsity conjunct at the root fails. In tilded essence the universal non-i condition holds, and no world has value *i. Both accident truth clauses fail, and the falsity implications for accident and tilded accident are true, respectively by vacuous antecedent and by universal non-*i. The resulting constants are t for essence and f for accident, including the tilded versions. This simultaneously proves preservation and propositional locality by induction over all terms; constants can be written using q→q and its negation on these valuations. For any of the target indices, the selected status on t,f is one of the two values, both fixed by conflation. Use that value at the common root and its opposite at the added accessible world for un-tilded targets, or flip those two assignments for tilded targets. Substituting into the exact-value clauses and the component-test clauses yields t to f for each essence form and f to t for each accident form. These are differences in designated truth as well as in full value. All atoms including freely valued parameters agree at the two roots, so none can save a definition. The argument covers arbitrary nonempty universal clusters and unbounded nesting in the stated signature; it does not purport to rule out richer-language translations. The printed finite tests were inspected but not rerun; the proof is the structural induction and these symbolic evaluations.

originality.rationale: The defining paper poses the same-family pair nondefinabilities as a hypothesis, not a proved theorem. The independently checked proof establishes those cases and proves the stronger joint-eight-operator obstruction. The richer-language embeddings and closest catalog comparison do not establish this locality obstruction for the restricted language.
residual_risks: The search cannot exclude an equivalent status-indexed theorem under different terminology. The attempted independent retrieval of Odintsov–Skurt–Wansing (DOI 10.12775/LLP.2019.010) timed out, so no new full-text negative comparison for that broader FDE paper is asserted.
Comparison of versions is limited to the relevant inspected passages, and a bounded erratum search is not a guarantee that no erratum exists.

value.rationale: Settling a named connective-definability problem for all sixteen targets is useful in identifying what must be added to the language. The proof rules out the natural workaround of mixing all four b/n families and gives a reusable locality invariant, as well as explicit low-cardinality witnesses that separate even designated truth. This is a semantic expressivity result, not the mere observation that a few short candidate definitions fail.
